Bullet Point Formatter

Turn plain lines into a clean bulleted list with your choice of bullet symbol.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste one item per line.
  2. Pick a bullet style.
  3. Press Format and copy the list.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which bullet styles are available?

• bullet, – dash, * asterisk, → arrow and ✓ check mark.

How are lines handled?

One bullet per non-empty line; blank lines are skipped.

What happens to blank lines?

Blank lines are skipped, so pasting a spaced-out list still produces a clean result.
